subject: elimating long long; explicitly sized types

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: elimating long long; explicitly sized types
parts:
I'd like to get rid of all the long long types
so we can compile with the -pedantic option.

The only place this matters is in some I/O
and agrad constructors.

I think we can recode to use explicitly
sized types. We need to cover the following:

1 bit bool
8 bit char
16/32/64 bit signed/unsigned integer

We could also do this for floating point types,
but so far, all the platforms take float to
be 32-bit and double to be 64 bit.

If nobody has an opinion about how to do this,
I'm inclined to use Boost:

http://www.boost.org/doc/libs/1_51_0/libs/integer/doc/html/boost_integer/cstdint.html

- Bob
